data.name: Parameter.Help
data.value: Create a reusable configuration value without leaving the current task.

data.name: Secret.Help
data.value: Create write-only secret metadata and store its value in an eligible Vault.

data.name: NoEligibleVault
data.value: No Vault can be used from this scope. Create or grant a Vault first.

data.name: Secret.WriteOnly
data.value: The value is sent directly to the Vault and is never read back by the Console.

data.name: Secret.ValueWriteFailed

data.name: DefaultNamespaceOnly
